name: watchdog
description: Daily price watcher for bike shops, alerts via a notify command

scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests .github stryker.config.json package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests .github stryker.config.json package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:acceptance
scripts.test:mutation: node --test tests/unit/rules.test.ts tests/unit/diff.test.ts tests/unit/price.test.ts tests/unit/sanitize.test.ts tests/unit/state.test.ts tests/unit/history.test.ts tests/unit/message.test.ts tests/unit/watches.test.ts
